title: P2 proposal.link_commit: request
description: The proposal executor or a person with proposal.decide:<category> links an accepted proposal with an applied commit. The core checks the commit: it is applied (MAN-5), touches only the tenant's folder, changes the named fields to the accepted values or in the named direction; only then is the proposal realized (PRP-19). A commit that touches other folders is not linked: proposal_scope (PRP-8). Denials: not_found, forbidden, proposal_scope.

commit.description: Id of the applied git commit.
